note: meta_tables_008000 is read as $&meta_tables_008000+N with DBR=$01 (34 sites in bank-0 engine code and bank-2 library code). The reads are base-relative, so the position inside bank 1 is free, but a cross-bank move breaks every one of them. movable:false pins the block to the bank of its start (32768 -> bank 01).
